data.name: Namratha
data.gender_notes: Namratha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘namas’, meaning bow or adoration, and ‘ratha’ meaning chariot. The name Namratha symbolizes a person who is pleased and delights in the divine. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of various goddesses. The name Namratha carries the meaning “Delight, Pleased, Graceful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Namratha usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleased, graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies devotion and grace.
data.etymology: Namratha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Pleased, Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Namratha total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: According to the Hindu Puranas, Namratha was the name of the divine cow who appeared before Lord Rama during his exile in the forest. She was sent by the gods to help Rama in his battle against Ravana.

Another reference to Namratha can be found in the 12th-century Sanskrit epic 'Vasavi Kanya'. In this story, Namratha is the name of the beautiful and virtuous daughter of King Indradyumna of Ujjain. She is famed for her unwavering devotion to Lord Vishnu.

In addition, Namratha is a popular name in the fashion and beauty industry, with several brands and influencers using it.
